text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening thesis with three reasons","quality":"organization","description":"It presents a clearer overall structure by stating a position and previewing the main reasons the essay will develop."},{"evidence":"three body paragraphs on fuel, safety, and technology","quality":"development","description":"It develops its argument with multiple elaborated points rather than briefly mentioning ideas and moving on."},{"evidence":"quoted details and paragraph references","quality":"textual support","description":"It uses more specific evidence from the article to back up its claims."},{"evidence":"links fuel savings to affordability and longer car use","quality":"reasoning","description":"It explains more fully why the evidence matters instead of only restating the source information."},{"evidence":"formal transitions like \"In addition\" and \"As mentioned earlier\"","quality":"cohesion","description":"It connects ideas more smoothly so the argument reads as a unified essay."},{"evidence":"intro-body-conclusion shape","quality":"essay completeness","description":"It more clearly follows the expected argumentative essay format with a developed beginning, middle, and ending."}]}
